__package__.yml.rawContents:
service:
  auth: false
  base-path: ''
  endpoints:
    UpdateDomain:
      path: /domain
      method: PATCH
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: UpdateDomainRequest
        body:
          properties:
            autorenewEnabled: optional<boolean>
            privacyEnabled: optional<boolean>
            locked: optional<boolean>
        content-type: application/json
      examples:
        - request: {}
    PostVariants:
      path: /variants
      method: POST
      source:
        openapi: ../openapi.yml
      request:
        name: PostVariantsRequest
        body:
          properties:
            addsProperty: optional<AnyOfBranchAddsProperty>
            narrowsProperty: optional<AnyOfBranchNarrowsProperty>
        content-type: application/json
      examples:
        - request: {}
  source:
    openapi: ../openapi.yml
types:
  AnyOfBranchAddsPropertyA:
    properties:
      a: boolean
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  AnyOfBranchAddsPropertyB:
    properties:
      b: boolean
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  AnyOfBranchAddsProperty:
    discriminated: false
    base-properties:
      a: optional<boolean>
    union:
      - AnyOfBranchAddsPropertyA
      - AnyOfBranchAddsPropertyB
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZeroKind:
    enum:
      - a
    inline: true
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZero:
    properties:
      kind: AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZeroKind
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOneKind:
    enum:
      - b
    inline: true
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
  AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOne:
    properties:
      kind: AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOneKind
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
    inline: true
  AnyOfBranchNarrowsProperty:
    discriminated: false
    base-properties:
      kind: optional<string>
      value: optional<string>
    union:
      - AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyZero
      - AnyOfBranchNarrowsPropertyOne
    source:
      openapi: ../openapi.yml
